result.topic_en: Euler discusses how the end conditions of a vibrating elastic rod (free, pinned by a pin, etc.) determine the constants and the length of the equivalent simple pendulum, treating first the free end and then the pinned end.

items.english: As soon as the state of the rod is defined, not only is the ratio of the constants α, β, γ, δ perfectly determined, but also an equation is obtained from which the value of f can be determined.
For a free end E (s = 0), the first equation requires d²y/ds² = 0 and the second gives d³y/ds³ = 0.
